headlines.title: Visa partners with Mesh for seamless stablecoin payments at stores
headlines.summary: Visa (V) is partnering with cryptocurrency payment platform Mesh to enable stablecoin and crypto balances to be spent on consumers' everyday transactions. Mesh co-founder and CEO Bam Azizi sits down with Brooke DiPalma to explain how this partnership works and how easy it will make using stablecoins to pay for goods everywhere Visa is accepted.

headlines.title: Visa Announces Enhanced Capabilities That Can Bring Trust and Control to the Future of Business Payments
headlines.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, October 21, 2026--Visa (NYSE: V) announced three capabilities across commercial card growth, virtual card security and agentic commerce for commercial payments. The capabilities are designed to help financial institutions, fintechs and businesses automate payment processes while maintaining the trust, visibility and control those transactions require for the future.

headlines.title: Visa, BILL and Billtrust pilot AI agents for invoice payments
headlines.summary: The pilot enables AI agents to be “securely authenticated” to credentialed supplier portals.

headlines.title: How Is Visa (V) Turning Crypto And AI Payments Into Real World Use?
headlines.summary: Visa (NYSE: V) partnered with Mesh to enable direct crypto and stablecoin payments at over 175 million merchants worldwide. The Mesh integration connects users' digital asset balances to Visa's network without requiring separate crypto cards or fiat cash-outs. Visa, BILL, and Billtrust started piloting AI agent driven B2B invoice payments aimed at automating secure accounts payable workflows.

headlines.title: Mesh and Visa Now Let You Spend Crypto at 175 Million Locations Without a Crypto Card. How Does It Work?
headlines.summary: Visa just opened 175 million merchants to crypto spenders, but the real catch has nothing to do with card readers or wallet apps. Every tap at checkout could quietly trigger a tax bill most users never see coming.

description: Visa Inc. operates as a payment technology company in the United States and internationally. The company operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. It also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers. In addition, the company provides acceptance solutions, an omnichannel payment integration with e-commerce platforms; risk detection and prevention solutions; and advisory and other services comprising consulting practice, proprietary analytics models, data scientists and economists, marketing services, and managed services. It provides its services under the Visa, Visa Electron, V PAY, Interlink, and PLUS brands. The company serves consumers, sellers, financial institutions, and government entities. Visa Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
